name: Mad Packs | Trixz
description: Sweet, fruity, and candy-inspired — Trixz is an indica known for its rich dessert-like flavor and smooth, satisfying smoke. Notes of mixed berries and creamy candy blend with subtle tropical sweetness for a bold, flavorful experience. Trixz delivers a euphoric, relaxing high that melts into soothing body effects, making it a great choice for unwinding, easing stress, and settling into a calm, laid-back evening.
